title: Gold Rewards Card: Managing Your Account and Payment Options
summary: This document explains how to manage a Gold Rewards Card account: minimum payments (2.0% of outstanding balance plus past-due, or full balance if lower), payment methods (autopay, one-time ACH, manual by due date), late fee ($32.50), APR (17.99%), and annual fee ($0.00). It also covers rewards (2.5% cash back; redeem once rewards reach $15), purchase protection (105 days; up to $7,500 per claim), and credit limits (typical $17,500–$112,500; review for increases with recent on-time payments and updated income).
